title: 第一卷 第2章 太子爷的惩罚-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    与浴室中的潮湿焦灼不同，原木风卧室中，霖多多穿着清凉的睡裙，半躺在床上吹着空调，跟闺蜜彭源悠哉的视频聊天。

    “多多，你说你运气怎么就那么好，抽奖从来不空，这次还直接领回家这么一大帅哥！”手机屏幕中，一个微胖脸圆的女生坐在炸鸡店，羡慕的眼睛发亮，“它怎么不量产呢？这样我想方设法也要买一个回来过过瘾！”

    “好像说是私人订制，外观申请了专利，不允许模仿或量产”，霖多多语气随意，“反正再帅也是假的，没有灵魂没有思想，还不好控制，不听话爱顶嘴总想逃，能给人气死！我猜就是因为这些bug，他才会被当成奖品让人免费抽走的。”

    彭源“啧”了一声：“再气人不也被你调教好了？现在能做饭会打扫的，羡慕死个人咯~”

    “我可不会调教，全靠他自带的电击惩罚，不叫主人或是不听话就电，连续电了三四天，想不乖都难。至于做饭”，霖多多的神情一言难尽，“巨难吃，简直要毒死人！打扫嘛倒是还可以”，她脸上终于露出些许满意，“它打扫卫生超精细，一丝不苟，设计它的人肯定有洁癖！”

    二人正聊着，敲门声不重不轻的响起。

    “进来！”霖多多头也不转的说道。

    上官程推门而入，西装外套已穿回身上，整理的一丝不苟，仿佛要出席商务晚宴。看到霖多多只穿了条吊带睡裙，他立刻别开眼睛，十分程式化的说道：“主人，浴室打扫完毕，请检查。”

    “不用了，你打扫我放心！”霖多多一个咕噜坐在床边，将胳膊伸过去，“来帮我按个摩，爬了一天山，挖了一天石头，胳膊酸死了。”

    上个月，专研小组接了成立以来第一个大单，为本市唯一一个超五星级酒店绘制巨型岩彩。有几种矿物颜料告急，霖多多为了补料，这段时间没少进山寻石。

    “瞿爽就是故意难为你，才让你一个小姑娘去找石头的！”提到寻石，原本平静的彭源，突然愤愤不平，连炸鸡都顾不上吃，“她算什么组长？！仗势欺人，尖酸刻薄！嫉妒你的天赋，就处处针对！竟然安排你一个女生去深山老林找矿料！简直丧心病狂！”

    “没事啦”，霖多多不甚在意的笑了笑，“就当是增加实践经验了，我现在寻矿那是越来越快了！而且还淘到不少品级高的宝石，再多攒点就能还上贷款了！”

    A市艺术学院是国际一流艺术类院校，学费高达每年10万，霖多多靠拿奖学金抵了一半学费，可剩下的依旧是笔不小的数目，她只能贷款。再加上先前为了给姥姥治病的借款，她堪称债台高筑。

    “你怎么总这么乐观啊，被人欺负了还不当回事”，彭源愤慨又无奈，“原本汪教授给你派了俩同学帮忙的，全被她暗中调走了。我看她就是巴不得你在野外出事，这样就没人跟她抢年纪第一了！”

    “你可别诅咒我啊！”霖多多半开玩笑的瞪了她一眼，“你刚还说我运气爆好呢，怎么可能出意外？”

    “我是担心你！”彭源越说越焦急，“明天我跟你一起进山，你别再拒绝了，就当支持我减肥了！”

    霖多多目露嫌弃：“得了吧你！带上你个小胖胖，更容易出事好嘛！而且就差白云母了，这种矿料很常见，我老家这边的溪山里就有。那山我从小玩到大，跟后花园似的，绝对没问题。你就安心在画室干活吧！汪教授后天出差回来，可是要检查你作业的。”

    提到检查作业，彭源发怵了一瞬，但还是执意要陪霖多多进山。

Page (1/3)

Unlike the humidity and anxiety in the bathroom, in the log-style bedroom, Lin Duoduo was wearing a cool nightgown, half-lying on the bed with the air conditioner blowing on, and leisurely video chatting with her best friend Peng Yuan.

"Duoduo, why are you so lucky? The lottery is never empty, and this time you brought home such a handsome guy!" On the screen of the mobile phone, a girl with a slightly chubby face was sitting in a fried chicken restaurant, her eyes shining with envy, "Why isn't it mass-produced? So I will try my best to buy one and enjoy it!"

"It seems that it is a private customization. The appearance is patented and no imitation or mass production is allowed." Lin Duoduo said in a casual tone. "No matter how handsome he is, he is still fake. He has no soul and no thoughts. He is not easy to control. He is disobedient and always wants to run away. It makes people mad! I guess it is because of these bugs that he is treated as a prize and taken away for free."

Peng Yuan let out a "tsk" sound: "No matter how angry I am, you have taught me how to train me? Now I can cook and clean, I'm so jealous~"

"I don't know how to train him. I rely on the electric shock punishment that comes with him. He will shock him if he doesn't call the master or if he doesn't obey. After three or four days of continuous electric shock, it's hard to be disobedient. As for cooking," Lin Duoduo's expression was hard to describe. "It tastes terrible. It's almost poisonous! Cleaning is okay." She finally showed some satisfaction on her face. "It cleans super finely and meticulously. The person who designed it must have a mysophobia!"

The two were chatting when a knock on the door sounded.

"Come in!" Lin Duoduo said without turning his head.

Shangguan Cheng pushed open the door and walked in. He had put on his suit jacket and arranged it meticulously, as if he was going to attend a business dinner.Seeing that Lin Duoduo was only wearing a suspender nightgown, he immediately averted his eyes and said in a very stylized manner: "Master, the bathroom has been cleaned, please check."

"No, I can rest assured that you can clean it!" Lin Duoduo sat beside the bed and stretched out his arm, "Come and give me a massage. After a day of climbing mountains and digging rocks, my arms are so sore."

Last month, the research team received its first big order since its establishment, painting giant rock colors for the only super five-star hotel in the city.Several mineral pigments were in urgent need, and Lin Duoduo went to the mountains to look for rocks during this period in order to replenish the supplies.

"Qu Shuang deliberately made things difficult for you, so he asked you, a little girl, to look for rocks!" When it came to looking for rocks, Peng Yuan, who was originally calm, suddenly became so angry that he didn't even bother to eat fried chicken. "What kind of team leader is she?! Bullying and mean! Jealous of your talent, she targets you everywhere! She even arranged for a girl like you to go to the mountains and old forests to look for minerals! It's so crazy!"

"It's okay," Lin Duoduo smiled nonchalantly, "Just think of it as gaining practical experience. My prospecting is getting faster and faster now! And I also found a lot of high-grade gemstones. If I save more, I can repay the loan!"

City A Art Institute is a world-class art school with tuition fees of up to 100,000 yuan per year. Lin Duoduo paid for half of the tuition fees with scholarships, but the remaining amount was still a large amount, so she could only take out a loan.Coupled with the previous loan to treat her grandma, she was in deep debt.

"Why are you always so optimistic? You didn't take it seriously when you were bullied." Peng Yuan was angry and helpless. "Professor Wang originally sent two classmates to help you, but she secretly transferred them all. I think she just wants you to have an accident in the wild, so that no one will compete with her for the first place!"

"Don't curse me!" Lin Duoduo glared at her half-jokingly, "You just said I was lucky, how could something happen to me?"

"I'm worried about you!" Peng Yuan became more and more anxious as he spoke, "I will go into the mountains with you tomorrow. Don't refuse anymore. Just treat it as supporting me in losing weight!"

Lin Duoduo looked disgusted: "Come on! Bring your chubby little one, it will be easier to get into trouble! And the only thing missing is muscovite. This kind of mineral material is very common, and it can be found in Xishan in my hometown. I grew up playing in that mountain, and it is like a back garden. There is absolutely no problem. You can just work in the studio without any worries! Professor Wang will come back from a business trip the day after tomorrow, but he will check your homework."

When it came to checking the homework, Peng Yuan was frightened for a moment, but he still insisted on accompanying Lin Duoduo into the mountains.
